name: latchkit
description: Your agents. One workflow. Open-source skills and local configuration for coding agents.
author: Guilherme Jacob

scripts.format: prettier --write src web scripts test package.json .github/workflows/ci.yml .prettierrc.json eslint.config.js *.md skills/**/*.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src web scripts test package.json .github/workflows/ci.yml .prettierrc.json eslint.config.js *.md skills/**/*.md
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && node scripts/check.js
